question: After a runtime patch pack removes a resource path and moves its UID to a new path, does the removed path remain reverse-mapped to that UID?

sources.title: ResourceUID cache merge implementation
sources.claim: load_from_cache(false) overwrites the UID forward entry but inserts the new reverse entry without removing an older reverse path

sources.title: Runtime pack overlay implementation
sources.claim: patch removals erase prior packed paths while replacement packs can overlay files

distinguishing_outcomes: After patch: old_exists=false, uid_to_path=new, path_to_uid(old)=uid: retain the stale reverse-alias finding with a real runtime pack consequence.
After patch: old_exists=false, uid_to_path=new, path_to_uid(old)=old path unchanged: source assumptions are incomplete or runtime reconciles the reverse map elsewhere.
Old path still exists after patch: investigate PCK removal/overlay setup separately from ResourceUID semantics.
Headless and rendered results differ: investigate pack/file backend selection before widening the claim.
stop_condition: Obtain one complete base-pack and replacement-pack receipt sequence in a built Godot runtime, or retain the exact execution blocker.
